name: hatchlock
description: Blocks type-checker escape hatches (@ts-ignore, as any, # type: ignore) before they land, gates edits on your local compilers across 17 languages, adds 6 LSP servers missing from the official set, and ships minimal-diff, optimization, and architecture skills.

disabled_languages.title: Disabled languages
disabled_languages.description: Comma-separated languages HatchLock should not check, e.g. "go, rust". Names: typescript, python, rust, go, cpp, zig, java, csharp, php, ruby, elixir, swift, kotlin, dart, lua, shell, terraform, r.
